enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Screaming: Screaming weapons emit a piercing screech whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This screech does an additional 1 to 6 sonic damage.
Weapon Focus: Falchion: While equipped this item gives you the feat Weapon Focus: Slashing but only for Falchions, giving a +1 to your attack bonus while using Falchions.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
